title: How Jack Friks reached $35k MRR with Post Bridge after years of trying everything
summary: Jack Friks dropped out of college to make money online, tried print-on-demand, affiliate blogs, 2000+ YouTube videos and crypto, then learned to code. Post Bridge now makes $35K USD MRR, doubling in six months after an eight-month plateau. Only the intro is visible; the rest of the article is paywalled.

principles.text: Try many things; the failed experiments eventually lead to the one that works.
Learning to code and building your own apps turned online hustle into a real product business.
principles.quote: Finally, three years ago, I decided to learn to code and build my own apps.

principles.text: Plateaus are normal; growth can resume after long flat stretches.
principles.quote: In the last six months, I doubled the MRR after an eight-month plateau.
